narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a commercial promotion for Cold Stone Creamery's 18th anniversary. It uses a nostalgic 'back to age 18' theme to introduce new tiramisu-flavored ice cream products (Baileys and Cocoa) and encourages viewers to participate in a LINE-based anniversary promotion.
